dedupe_keys.name: dados dos indicadores de confiabilidade da rede basica atls atendimento aos limites sistemicos

description: ONS publishes ATLS performance indicators for compliance with systemic power-flow limits. The dictionary identifies each flow, reference month, compliance percentage and hours above the established limit. Reporting periods distinguish monthly values from accumulation within the year. These quantities support transmission-capacity and reliability studies. They describe performance against defined limits; they do not provide the complete network topology or individual line parameters. Coverage is named systemic electricity flows in Brazil. The catalogue lists CSV, Excel and Parquet files; files are free under the provider's CC-BY terms, with no version specified. ONS requires attribution and disclosure of changes. Data contents were not downloaded; completeness is unknown, and published values may be revised. Related ONS generation-by-plant data provide a comparison series.
